nodes.author: Gonzo_Sprocko
nodes.text:
I suspect a trojan horse mechanism may have been incorporated into the death pricks called VP-40. Not to be confused with the SV-40 that has been proclaimed by others.
That is another issue altogether.

nodes.author: Gonzo_Sprocko
nodes.text: VP-40 can be used to allow viruses such as but not limited to HIV, ZIKA, EBOLA, MARBURG into the body undetected which can later be triggered by remote drug delivery or even environmental exposure to a chemical trigger.

nodes.author: Gonzo_Sprocko
nodes.text: Marburg and Ebola have terrifying mortality rates and I feel this may have been what Gate's was talking about when he said the next plandemic will get their attention next time.

nodes.author: Gonzo_Sprocko
nodes.text: A quick search of Gate's patents will also show he owns a patent on just such a "nano delivery bot" that could effectively accomplish this using this or other mechanisms that could have been incorporated into the "vaccines"

nodes.author: Gonzo_Sprocko
nodes.text: I will again emphasize that this is speculative however it's more of an inference than a hypothesis and very specific testing would need to be done to determine or falsify this while it remains plausible.

nodes.author: Gonzo_Sprocko
nodes.text: I have spoken about this at great lengths in the past even long prior to Gate's "We'll get you next time" threat and was called "crazy"...
